title: Gerrymandering: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
summary: A Last Week Tonight episode segment in which John Oliver explains gerrymandering, how lawmakers reshape voting districts to shift political power. It uses humor and examples such as oddly shaped districts.
why: HN cites it as an entertaining, fact-based explainer of gerrymandering tactics, though one commenter criticizes it as inconsistent.

quote.text: I highly recommend the John Oliver explanation
